item.title: Lark vs PyParsing vs PLY in 2026: Python Parser Libraries After PLY's Retirement
item.description: On 21 December 2025, David Beazley posted a short notice at the top of the PLY README: after 25 years, he was abandoning the project. No further maintenance. His suggestion for users was to copy the library into their own tree or write a parser by hand. If your codebase still imports ply.yacc, that notice is the most important paragraph in your dependency review this quarter.
